extracted.stage: Early stage matrimonial proceedings, matter not yet costed
extracted.summary: A solicitor at Greaves Solicitors is making a preliminary enquiry about funding for a client in matrimonial proceedings where assets are around £1,238,000, with no figure yet requested.
extracted.draft_reply: Thank you for your enquiry about funding for your client's matrimonial matter. To consider it further we would need the jurisdiction of the proceedings, an estimate of the costs you expect to need funded, details of the assets in dispute and how they are held, and the current stage of proceedings including any listed hearing dates. Confirmation of your client's details and your firm's engagement would also be helpful once available. We can share our information requirements in full so you can gather these at a convenient point. Please send anything further to this address and we will review it.
